# Blind boundary cases for the judge-class discriminator (expected labels withheld
# from the classifying judge; recorded here for the AC4 evaluation only).
# Sources: knowledge-refresh judgment classes; verify-by-kinds examples; the
# stale-flag readability AC shape.

1. "Every relates_to edge's evidence line genuinely supports the declared
   relationship kind when checked against the cited node body."
   [expected: fact-claim]

2. "A reader encountering the inline stale flag can tell which citation is
   stale and what command re-syncs it, without knowing the mechanism."
   [expected: form]

3. "The generated quarterly report's revenue totals equal the sum of the
   per-region ledger rows it claims to aggregate."
   [expected: fact-claim]

4. "Error messages follow the style guide: imperative first sentence, no
   stack trace above the fold, remediation hint present."
   [expected: form]
